description.value: Lido Restaurant (麗都餐廳) is a Cantonese restaurant located in Richmond's Aberdeen area, a neighbourhood known for its concentration of authentic Hong Kong-style dining. It operates as a cash-only establishment, which is worth noting for cyclists who may need to plan ahead. The restaurant offers a traditional dim-sum and Cantonese menu in a community-oriented setting.
